PDI_architecture_blocker.issue: PDI conductivity can depend on soil temperature through vapor conductivity. A hydraulic-parameter-only immutable K table therefore does not preserve source semantics across changing temperature.
PDI_architecture_blocker.required_next_question: Can PDI K be factorized into a frozen pressure-head/parameter component plus a cheap authoritative temperature-dependent component, or must temperature become an explicit representation coordinate?
PDI_architecture_blocker.reason_not_to_continue_blindly: Choosing either factorization or a multidimensional h-temperature representation changes cache identity and representation architecture and requires separate source-level authority analysis.
